summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $478M+ accumulations in SPX 1000C (2027) and $384M in SPX 7000C (2026) contracts. Significant directional conviction is visible in the semiconductor space, with MU seeing $604M in BuyCalls against only $334.7M in BuyPuts, and SNDK showing a highly aggressive P/C ratio of 0.52. Persistent institutional interest is concentrated in extreme out-of-the-money SPX calls, specifically the 7000C (exp 2026-10-16) which has seen $5B in accumulation over the last four sessions. Traders should monitor for continued upside momentum in SPX and MU, while watching for any reversal signals in TLT, which is seeing heavy Put dominance (P/C 1.82).
